_note: Outdoor weather. Used by presets whose aerosol.inactivation is "humidity" (influenza): heated outdoor air keeps its water, so indoor RH = outdoor RH x sat(outdoor_temp_c) / sat(indoor_temp_c) (Magnus; unchanged when outdoor_temp_c >= indoor_temp_c), and airborne flu inactivation rises from 0.29/h at indoor RH <= 25% to 1.61/h at >= 45% (Noti et al. 2013). Same formula and defaults as model/infer.js and exposure/flu_risk.py. daily: optional per-sim-day overrides [{"outdoor_rh_pct": .., "outdoor_temp_c": ..}, ...]; missing keys use the values above, and days past the end of the list repeat its last entry.
